faq.q: How does the AI service picker choose my providers?
faq.a: You describe your project in your own words. Our recommendation engine evaluates scope, timing, location, and budget to surface a curated shortlist of three pre-qualified providers ranked by fit. You can adjust preferences or request additional matches at any time.

faq.q: What does gated provider identity mean for me?
faq.a: Provider names, phone numbers, and reviews remain hidden until both sides confirm a match. This protects your personal information, eliminates unwanted sales calls, and ensures that every introduction is a serious, mutual commitment.

faq.q: How do milestone-based payments work?
faq.a: Your project is divided into clearly defined phases. Funds are held in escrow and released only when each milestone is verified as complete. You approve every draw before money moves, so you never pay for work that has not been finished and inspected.

faq.q: Can I track my provider on the day of service?
faq.a: Yes. Once your provider is dispatched, you receive real-time GPS updates showing their ETA and current status. You will also get automatic notifications when they are en route, on-site, and when the job is marked complete.

faq.q: Is Homeworke free for homeowners?
faq.a: Creating an account and browsing the marketplace is free. Service fees are transparently built into each project quote so there are no hidden charges. You will always see the full cost before confirming a match.

faq.q: What if my real estate agent recommended Homeworke?
faq.a: If you were invited by a real estate professional, their referral is tracked within the platform. This adds an extra layer of accountability — your agent's reputation is tied to the quality of the providers they recommend, and you benefit from that trusted relationship.

faq.q: How do I share my inspection report into Homeworke?
faq.a: You can upload or link your report directly through the Homeworke platform. Individual findings are parsed into actionable line items that feed into the project workflow, provider matching, and negotiation tools. No special formatting is required.

faq.q: Will my report be visible to service providers?
faq.a: Relevant findings are shared with providers only after the homeowner or agent engages them. Provider identities are gated until commitment, and your full report remains accessible only to the parties you authorize through the sharing workflow.

faq.q: How does Homeworke support repair negotiations using my findings?
faq.a: Each flagged item in your report can be matched with up to three curated service providers through the AI service picker. The resulting estimates give agents and buyers concrete numbers to work with during negotiations, grounded in your professional assessment.

faq.q: Do I get updates on what happens after my inspection?
faq.a: Yes. You receive milestone-based updates as repair items progress from estimate through completion. PM on-the-way notifications and milestone payment draws give you clear visibility into how your findings are being addressed.

faq.q: How does this help me get more referrals from agents?
faq.a: The relationship engine tracks collaboration patterns between inspectors and agents. When your reports consistently drive smooth repair workflows, you build platform reputation that surfaces you to active offices and agents looking for reliable inspection partners.

faq.q: Is there a cost for inspectors to use Homeworke?
faq.a: Homeworke is designed to add value to your existing inspection workflow at no additional cost. Your participation strengthens the ecosystem for agents, buyers, and providers, and the platform rewards that contribution through increased visibility and referral opportunities.

faq.q: What is the Admitted Partner Program?
faq.a: It is a revenue-sharing program for licensed real estate professionals. When a client you invited completes a milestone-verified job through Homeworke, you earn a transparent payout. There are no fees to join — compensation is tied entirely to successful outcomes.

faq.q: How do office dashboards work for brokerages?
faq.a: A designated broker or team lead gets a roll-up view of every agent under their office. You can filter by agent, date range, service category, and job status. Revenue forecasts and job-volume trends update weekly so you can track ROI without chasing spreadsheets.

faq.q: Which CRMs does Homeworke integrate with?
faq.a: At launch, Homeworke supports two-way sync with Follow Up Boss and kvCORE. Additional integrations are on the roadmap. All data transfers use enterprise-grade encryption, and client records auto-tag by service history and job status.

faq.q: How are providers vetted before they reach my clients?
faq.a: Every provider passes a gated onboarding process that includes background checks, license verification, and insurance validation. Clients receive a curated shortlist of three matched providers by default, and provider identity remains hidden until the client confirms a match.

faq.q: Do my clients pay anything extra for using my link?
faq.a: No. Clients pay the same milestone-based project price whether they arrive through your branded page or directly. Your payout comes from Homeworke, not from an upcharge on the client side.

faq.q: Can I invite clients I closed years ago?
faq.a: Absolutely. You can invite any past client via email, text, or QR code at any time. The automated post-close drip keeps your page top of mind, but a manual invite works just as well for re-engaging older contacts.

faq.q: What does the gated onboarding process involve?
faq.a: You will submit your trade license, proof of insurance, and consent to a background check. Our team reviews each application manually. Most providers receive a decision within 48 hours. The bar is intentional — it keeps the marketplace competitive and trustworthy for everyone.

faq.q: How does the job feed decide which projects I see?
faq.a: The feed filters by your registered trade specialties, your service radius, and your real-time calendar availability. You will only see projects you are qualified for and can actually schedule. No noise, no irrelevant leads.

faq.q: When and how do I get paid?
faq.a: Payments are structured around milestones defined before the project starts. When you complete a milestone and it is confirmed in the app, funds are released to your connected bank account. There are no platform-imposed net-30 or net-60 delays.

faq.q: Is there a fee to join or a per-lead charge?
faq.a: Homeworke does not charge providers a subscription fee or a per-lead fee. The platform operates on a transaction-based model tied to completed milestones. You only pay when you earn.

faq.q: How does calendar sync work with my existing tools?
faq.a: Connect your Google Calendar, Outlook, or iCal account during setup. Homeworke reads your existing events to determine open slots and writes new bookings back to your calendar automatically. The sync is two-way and updates in real time.

faq.q: What happens if a homeowner disputes a milestone?
faq.a: Every milestone includes built-in documentation — photos, timestamps, and confirmation prompts. If a dispute arises, our resolution team reviews the evidence on file. The structured process protects providers who do the work and document it properly.
